comments.body:
Thank you for your contribution! CI is currently failing because of an update in main.

`TestPlugin_LateHookDoesNotEmitAfterInvocationEnd` panics with `assignment to entry in nil map` at `telemetry/plugin.go:441`, in `upsertOperationLocked`, when `onOperationStart` runs. #171 added the `resultText` field to `telemetryInvocation`, and `upsertOperationLocked` now writes to it. The tests in `telemetry/plugin_end_test.go` create `telemetryInvocation` as a struct literal that sets `byOpID` but not `resultText`, so the map is nil. The check (telemetry) and supported-go (telemetry) jobs fail on Go 1.24, 1.26 and 1.27. `TestPlugin_ConcurrentHooksAndInvocationEnd` uses the same literal and will hit the same panic once the first test no longer aborts the package.

To fix it, add `resultText: make(map[string]string)` to both struct literals in `plugin_end_test.go`. A more durable fix is to build the invocation with the plugin's own constructor, so fields added later do not break these tests. Then update the branch to the latest `main` and re-run CI.
